title: Flatten One Level
prompt: A form groups answers by section, but the summary view needs one list. Given an array of arrays, write a function that returns a single array with all inner values concatenated in order, flattening exactly one level.

explanation.beginner:
Example: flattenOnce([[1,2],[3],[4,5]]) produces [1,2,3,4,5]. The result must follow this precise rule: A form groups answers by section, but the summary view needs one list. Given an array of arrays, write a function that returns a single array with all inner values concatenated in order, flattening exactly one level. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “handles empty inner arrays”: input [[[],[1],[]]] produces [1]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
